apps.name: Apollo
apps.subtitle: Apollo for Reddit with ApolloReborn
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project's ongoing fixes and enhancements.

This source mirrors the GLASS Icons variant, which bundles the Liquid Glass alternate icon catalog without the iOS 26 UI runtime opt-in, so legacy UIKit behaviors such as the bottom tab bar swipe gesture are preserved.

This source is intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to save media or to select images to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Detect rotations in Media Viewer and offer corresponding options.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Checked once to calculate sunset/sunrise times for the location.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Apollo when re-opening in order to prevent unauthorized access.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/releases/tag/v1.15.11_3.8.0
Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-3.8.0-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add Save All Media to save every image, GIF, and video in a Reddit gallery, Imgur album, or ImageChest post at once, from the fullscreen viewer's menus or an album's long-press menu, with a progress ring and Cancel (#1048: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Fullscreen images offer Save Image next to Share, and holding an image in the viewer or a feed gallery offers Copy Image and Save Image for that image instead of jumping straight to the share sheet
  - Also fixes Download Video when only Reddit's copy is available, Save GIF in the share sheet, and missing post controls on albums opened from a link in a post
- Add Action Menus (Interface → Menus) to reorder and hide the actions in Apollo's ••• menus and, for moderators, its moderator menus, one menu at a time with a live preview (#1131: @icpryde)
- Redesign the Account Switcher as a themed bottom sheet with larger avatars, Add Account and Edit at the top, and drag-to-reorder that no longer refreshes your feed (#1077: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Also fixes a crash when switching accounts
- Add Automatic Backups (Data → Backup Settings) — pick a folder in Files and your settings are backed up there every day, three days, or seven days, keeping the ten most recent automatic backups (#1060, #1148, #1152: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Backups now save as ".apollobackup" files with the Apollo icon, and opening one from Files asks before restoring; existing ".zip" backups still restore
- Add Settings Shortcuts — press and hold the Settings tab to jump straight to up to 15 settings pages, chosen and reordered under Interface → Tab Bar → Settings Shortcuts (#1150: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add a Return Button that appears beside Back after a status-bar tap takes you to the top; tap it, or the status bar again, to jump back to where you were reading, now on Liquid Glass too (#1116: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Turn the button off under Interface → Display & Navigation; the second status-bar tap keeps working either way
- Rework Hidden & Deleted into a profile row that opens one combined feed of archived posts and comments, labeled Hidden, Removed, or Deleted, with inline images and swipeable albums (#1137: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add Profile Picture Shape (Interface → Display & Navigation) to show profile pictures as Full, Circle, or rounded Square across posts, comments, messages, the profile tab, and the Account Switcher (#1136: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Extend Immersive profile artwork behind the status and navigation bars with a wider crop and smoother fade, and long-press a profile banner to view it fullscreen and save it (#1186: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Play GIF and video tiles silently in Gallery View's grid while they're on screen, with separate Play Videos in Gallery View and Play GIFs in Gallery View switches (Media → Browsing, on by default) (#1142: @icpryde)
- Speed up opening and closing images and albums — albums zoom straight out of the feed thumbnail like single images, the background fades as you swipe media away, and closing an album returns the feed carousel to the last image you viewed (#1143: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Smooth out scrolling through video-heavy feeds — playing videos take far less of the app's time, and the new Smoother Video Scrolling switch (Posts & Feeds → Feed, on by default) prepares players in the background and lets video posts draw without stalling the scroll (#1168: @icpryde)
- Keep unsent Chat drafts in modern Direct Chat, saved per account and conversation and restored when you come back (#1207: @Thetromboneman1)
- Add Swipe Tab Bar to Navigate (Interface → Tab Bar, Liquid Glass, off by default) to swipe the tab bar back and forward again in place of the native drag-to-switch-tabs gesture; takes effect after relaunching (#1075: @DeltAndy123)
- Add Confirm Favorite Changes (Subreddits → Favorites, off by default) so the star on the Subreddits list asks before adding or removing a favorite (#1173: @nunoo)

Fixes

- Fix a startup crash loop after adding an account while Reddit is rate-limiting; an unexpected listing response now fails like any other load (#1147: @icpryde)
- Fix a crash on launch or when switching accounts after changing your Reddit password; Apollo now tries to recover the expired session and asks you to sign in again if it can't (#1200: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix crashes loading older comments in Live Update mode and choosing Open in Safari on a shared GIF or other downloaded media (#1171: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a crash when touching and holding a post while the feed scrolls (#1193: @icpryde)
- Fix a crash tapping Cancel on a subreddit search with results on non-Liquid-Glass builds (#1133: @icpryde)
- Bring back Copy with Account in Copy Widget Setup Code, lost in 3.7.1, so Home and multireddit widgets can use your account again (#1195: @icpryde)
- Fix Gallery View hiding its first row of tiles under the navigation bar since 3.7.1, and its spinner staying up after changing the filter while it loads (#1140, #1194: @icpryde)
  - Holding a video in the viewer opens Save/Share without letting go, and dragging down with that sheet open no longer leaves the viewer black and unresponsive
- Fix the Liquid Glass feed search bar springing back open after you scroll it away, staying pinned when you scroll right after cancelling a search, and the Hard header style cutting off the top of the field (#1130, #1146: @icpryde)
  - Collapsing a comment no longer jumps the thread or flashes a band across the top, Find in Comments swaps its buttons smoothly, and a cancelled swipe-back keeps the search field's glass
- Keep the Settings search field below the title while searching on Liquid Glass instead of sliding up over it (#1156: @icpryde)
- Make Apollo Reborn settings follow Apollo's Text Size and match the native rows' font weight and text colors, including the softer gray in Pure Black mode (#1165: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix Apollo Reborn settings screens stuttering or refusing to scroll back up, footer text drawing over the rows above it, and the list shifting after a swipe back (#1170: @icpryde)
- Soften the row highlight when you tap a row — stock themes use Apollo's original gray again and custom themes a lighter tint of their accent (#1166: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix subreddit list editing — favorite stars stay aligned, long names stop short of the star, confirmation buttons stay tappable, rows no longer stay highlighted, and removals animate smoothly (#1174: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the header visible while editing the subreddit list with Hide Header on Scroll on, and bring the header and tab bar back as soon as you tap the status bar (#1120: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a brief stall when scrolling back down right after reaching the top of a post, and a stutter where Hide Header on Scroll kept hiding and revealing the header (#1119: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Make the Posts tab scroll to the top and then go back on profiles, trophies, multireddits, and posts opened from a profile, like it does on feeds (#1153: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a cancelled forward swipe erasing your navigation history, so swiping forward again reopens the page (#1128: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Reopen Floating Post Tabs on the comment sort you left them on, Live Update included, instead of the default sort (#1125: @icpryde)
- Fade a newly posted comment into the thread with its avatar and flair already in place, instead of the thread jumping and the avatar popping in afterwards (#1196: @icpryde)
- Fix collapsing a comment thread sliding its replies down before the comments below move up (#1180: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the comment age visible next to long usernames, which now truncate instead (#1162: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep recovered deleted comments readable when Apollo switches between light and dark mode while the thread is open (#1206: @Thetromboneman1)
- Fix feed usernames drifting right, leaving a growing gap after "by", each time you came back to the feed from a post with Translate Post Titles on (#1208: @icpryde)
- Fix rich link cards overlapping a post's details and vote buttons once they finish loading, in feeds and comment threads, including while you scroll (#1191: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the composer's GIF button staying over username and subreddit suggestions, and the formatting toolbar sitting partly behind the keyboard on iOS 27, on non-Liquid-Glass builds (#1164: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a Chat conversation you opened from the Inbox turning unread again, badge included, after a refresh when Use Modern Reddit Chat is on (#1141: @icpryde)
- Fix double-tapping the Search tab sometimes not opening the keyboard (#1190: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show the gallery counter in its usual top-right spot on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max instead of centered (#1189: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix Bark Notifications showing Bark's own icon when your app icon has no Bark artwork; they fall back to the default Apollo icon instead (#1204: @Thetromboneman1)
- Turn Swipe Up for Comments off by default (Media → Browsing); if you already switched it on or off, your choice is kept (#1134: @icpryde)

Upstream release: https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/releases/tag/v1.15.11_3.7.1
Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-3.7.1-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add Hide Header on Scroll (Interface → Tab Bar) so the Liquid Glass navigation bar follows the tab bar as it hides and reappears, in both Two-Gesture and Classic scroll modes (#1079: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Hide Bars on Scroll, Hide Style, Hide Header on Scroll, and Scroll Behavior are separate controls now, and Hide Style, Scroll Behavior, and Header Style pick from native glass menus that show the current choice in the row
  - Gallery View honors the selected Header Style while scrolling and after the bars come back, instead of leaving an opaque strip under the navigation controls

Fixes

- Fix swipe navigation feeling sluggish since 3.7.0 — pages settle with Apollo's original easing again after you lift your finger, on back, forward, and cancelled swipes (#1073: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the comment jump button stalling on the first parent comment since 3.7.0 — consecutive taps advance again without scrolling past the current comment first, and long-press to jump back uses the corrected position (#1094: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix posts opened from Community Highlights, deep links, Recently Read, Floating Post Tabs, and other "apollo://" routes ignoring the subreddit's suggested sort and your Remember Post Sort and Remember Subreddit Sort choices — they now open on the same comment sort a feed tap would (#1102: @icpryde)
- Fix several crashes: opening 3.7.0 on TrollStore and other ElleKit installs, a profile page still loading when you switch accounts or refresh, expanding or collapsing a multireddit in the subreddit list, and the notification fetcher reading settings that had just been replaced (#1089: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Classic (non-glass) builds running under LiveContainer no longer mistake themselves for Liquid Glass builds, the suspected cause of crashes opening search, settings, posts, and subreddits there
- Keep Liquid Glass builds from crashing when a feed element's bitmap can't be created, seen when tapping the Posts tab to return to the top of a long Popular feed; the element is left blank instead (#1099: @icpryde)
- Fix Keep in Floating Tab and the other Apollo Reborn rows in the legacy ⋯ sheet crashing the app when a third-party menu tweak such as Translomatic is installed (#1076: @icpryde)
- Fix videos going quiet after rotating the phone with the fullscreen viewer open, and stop a second video under the viewer from starting its own audio (#1080: @icpryde)
- Fix Add to Multireddit reporting "Error adding to multireddit" even though the subreddit was added, and the multireddit's subtitle lagging until the next refresh (#1081: @icpryde)
- Keep the Liquid Glass action pill expanded by default again — collapsing it into the ⋯ is now the opt-in Collapse Navigation Actions switch (Interface → Display & Navigation), and Center Title Between Buttons is back for the expanded layout (#1105: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Titles stay centered unless the expanded actions need the room, the pill no longer flashes when the subreddit picker opens or closes, and a startup recursion on the always-expanded path is fixed
- Restore Hidden as a Header Style option on Liquid Glass — it removes the top scroll-edge effect without adding a blur, and existing Hidden preferences and backups work again (#1074: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the Liquid Glass tab bar popping open and snapping back on iOS 27 when a Two-Gesture reveal starts with the Left or Right hide style (#1078: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show the +N new-comment count on Community Highlights again after a refresh (#1098: @IllIIllIllIllII)

apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: A Plex and Jellyfin client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern cross-platform Plex and Jellyfin client.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/releases/tag/2.21.0
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Library filters take multiple values, exclusions and ranges
- Downloads tabs can group, sort and filter
- Tag suggestions in the tag editor
- Quick Tag in the item context menu
- Shuffle Starts at Beginning setting
- A volume pill shows every volume change in the player
- Cmd+R or Ctrl+R refreshes the current page on desktop
- The Watch Together session code is large enough to read across a room
- Flatpak bundle for Linux

Performance

- Libraries in folder view open with fewer server requests
- Collections without a backdrop skip the poster blur on Reduced visual effects

Playback

- Ambient lighting turned on in settings applies when playback starts
- Subtitles stay in place with Ambient lighting after moving to the next episode
- NVScaler skips HDR content from the first frame
- NVScaler comes back for an SDR episode that follows an HDR one
- Files whose tracks end early finish and offer Play Next
- Switching episode or quality in place waits for the new file's first frame
- The skip badge matches the distance the playhead moved
- A slow server response no longer overwrites a replaced play queue
- The player no longer leaks memory each time it closes
- Transcoded playback starts through reverse proxies that send chunked responses
- Dolby Vision Profile 8 keeps HDR on TVs without Dolby Vision
- HDR10+ switches the TV to HDR10+ instead of HDR10 on Apple TV
- DTS-HD MA bitstreams in full instead of as DTS core on more TVs
- Fewer E-AC-3 passthrough dropouts on Fire TV
- Watch Together rooms start on Apple TV and with display matching on
- Playing alone in a Watch Together room starts on the first Play press

Subtitles

- PGS subtitles no longer draw a box behind the text
- Subtitles no longer make video stutter on low-end Android boxes

Live TV

- Live TV shows in system media controls, Now Playing and Google Assistant
- Next and previous change channel from media controls and the companion remote
- A short rewind at the live edge moves back instead of doing nothing
- Guide reloads and recording rule runs report failures instead of claiming success
- Favorite channels are included in settings export

Jellyfin & Emby

- External players open ISO files from Jellyfin
- Downloads keep their SRT subtitles on Jellyfin
- The Collections tab lists collections on Emby servers without a collections folder

Explore & trackers

- Unwatching resets MAL and AniList progress instead of deleting the list entry
- A failed watchlist add on Plex shows an error instead of doing nothing

Downloads

- Downloads stop before the device runs out of storage
- Show and season badges count downloaded episodes
- Downloads from different servers no longer merge into one show or album
- A shared download removed from a profile leaves that profile's list
- The offline play-next card shows its thumbnail on Jellyfin and Emby

UI

- Error messages no longer show raw technical text
- Titles without a logo get a wider slot and shrink to fit instead of truncating
- Low-density phones get the phone layout instead of the tablet one
- Hovering an always-open sidebar no longer dims the content
- Settings that fail to apply show why instead of crashing
- Out-of-date translations refreshed in every language

TV

- Plezy no longer renders upside down on some Android TV boxes
- The on-screen keyboard takes D-pad input on Chromecast with Google TV
- The focused player control is a solid disc that stands out over video
- Holding Select opens the context menu on playlist items
- The server activities cancel button is reachable with a remote

Android

- Non-16:9 video is letterboxed again on Android 7 and 8
- High-bitrate AV1 plays smoothly on Pixel 6 and newer
- Locking and unlocking during playback no longer blacks out the picture or desyncs audio
- The display no longer switches between 120 and 60 Hz mid-playback
- Frame pacing recovers after seeking on some tablets
- The performance overlay reports dropped frames accurately

Desktop

- HDR plays in HDR on macOS instead of tone-mapped to SDR
- Audio device changes no longer crash playback on macOS
- The player's fullscreen button follows fullscreen state on Windows
- The window no longer stays blank when FancyZones resizes it at launch
- Plezy no longer leaves .sentry-native folders in random directories on Windows
- Companion Remote can host on more Linux and Windows network adapters
- Discord presence hides while paused

Upstream release: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/releases/tag/2.20.0
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Discord shows a Listening card while music plays
- Original quality shows the source bitrate in the quality menu

Performance

- The performance overlay no longer delays the playback it measures
- The performance overlay reports cache use instead of N/A
- Less CPU spent on logging while browsing and playing

Playback

- A failed open shows a Retry screen instead of a snackbar and an empty player
- A file that cannot start fails in seconds instead of after thirty
- Slow software decoding keeps playing instead of failing with a video output error
- A wedged player recovers with Retry instead of needing a force stop
- Back leaves the player instead of stopping responding
- Starting another item from a shelf no longer strands a frozen player
- Playback ends with an audio error instead of freezing when the audio device stops responding
- Normalize Loudness applies on Android, as a stereo mix
- Normalize Loudness overrides Audio Passthrough instead of being ignored
- Dolby Vision Profile 5 plays with correct color on Google TV
- Dolby Vision Profile 5 plays at full rate on boxes wired to a non-Dolby Vision TV
- Letterbox bars are black instead of gray during HDR playback
- 4K HEVC Main 10 uses hardware decoding on more Android decoders
- AV1 keeps hardware decoding on Pixel 6 and newer through ambient mode and lock
- 5.1 audio bitstreams instead of downmixing to stereo on TVs that report an offload-only HDMI port
- Plezy is no longer killed mid-playback on low-memory TV boxes
- A track choice made just before leaving the item is remembered
- Remembered track selections apply on Jellyfin instead of being dropped
- Plezy says when a track choice can only apply to the current playback
- The audio and subtitle menu ticks the track that is playing

Display matching

- Deinterlaced content no longer drops every other frame with Match Content Frame Rate
- Frame-rate matching works on 90 Hz and 120 Hz panels
- 24p content matches 120 Hz instead of 48 Hz on high-refresh panels
- Content at odd rates such as 23.81 fps matches a near-native mode instead of 60 Hz
- HDR survives on displays that advertise HDR per resolution
- Playback resumes after the display has finished switching modes
- Android hardware playback follows refresh-rate changes the TV makes itself
- The display returns to its own mode after playback ends

Subtitles

- Korean subtitles render instead of separated jamo
- Typeset signs land on their cut on low-end Android boxes
- Positioned subtitles stay inside the picture on Android hardware playback, with a new Use margins setting
- The next episode plays its own subtitle track instead of the previous one's

Live TV

- Rewinding a channel plays from that point instead of skipping ahead
- Capped quality presets remux instead of re-encoding on Plex
- Capped quality presets allow direct play on Jellyfin and Emby
- Original quality is no longer capped at 8 Mbps on Jellyfin and Emby
- Emby channels direct play mpegts

UI

- Bottom navigation labels stay on one line in every language and font size
- Posters and thumbnails render sharper
- Durations under a minute show seconds

TV

- The control bar stays up long enough to walk with a remote, and never hides while paused
- Repeated skip presses move by the configured step instead of running away
- The focused row stays on screen in reorderable lists
- Arrow keys move through Edit Metadata choices instead of selecting one

Android

- The taskbar no longer covers the video after folding or unfolding
- Servers behind a user-installed certificate authority connect again
- Downloads work on Plex servers reached over IPv6
- Playback no longer stutters while the Watch Next shelf updates
- Fewer stalls and less judder during hardware playback

tvOS

- Live TV in HLG keeps HDR instead of falling back to SDR
- Episode auto-advance no longer blanks the picture and cuts HDMI audio

Desktop

- Closing Plezy on Windows no longer crashes
- TrueHD falls back to PCM instead of opening to silence on Windows

Linux

- Startup no longer hangs at "Connecting to servers..." on hosts without xdg-user-dirs
- Plezy starts on hosts without D-Bus or NetworkManager
- Source and AUR builds play against a system libmpv older than the pinned one
- mpv log lines no longer put a Plex token in the system journal
- CJK and Hangul text renders instead of tofu
- The performance overlay reports the display refresh rate

apps.versionDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/releases/tag/2.21.0
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Library filters take multiple values, exclusions and ranges
- Downloads tabs can group, sort and filter
- Tag suggestions in the tag editor
- Quick Tag in the item context menu
- Shuffle Starts at Beginning setting
- A volume pill shows every volume change in the player
- Cmd+R or Ctrl+R refreshes the current page on desktop
- The Watch Together session code is large enough to read across a room
- Flatpak bundle for Linux

Performance

- Libraries in folder view open with fewer server requests
- Collections without a backdrop skip the poster blur on Reduced visual effects

Playback

- Ambient lighting turned on in settings applies when playback starts
- Subtitles stay in place with Ambient lighting after moving to the next episode
- NVScaler skips HDR content from the first frame
- NVScaler comes back for an SDR episode that follows an HDR one
- Files whose tracks end early finish and offer Play Next
- Switching episode or quality in place waits for the new file's first frame
- The skip badge matches the distance the playhead moved
- A slow server response no longer overwrites a replaced play queue
- The player no longer leaks memory each time it closes
- Transcoded playback starts through reverse proxies that send chunked responses
- Dolby Vision Profile 8 keeps HDR on TVs without Dolby Vision
- HDR10+ switches the TV to HDR10+ instead of HDR10 on Apple TV
- DTS-HD MA bitstreams in full instead of as DTS core on more TVs
- Fewer E-AC-3 passthrough dropouts on Fire TV
- Watch Together rooms start on Apple TV and with display matching on
- Playing alone in a Watch Together room starts on the first Play press

Subtitles

- PGS subtitles no longer draw a box behind the text
- Subtitles no longer make video stutter on low-end Android boxes

Live TV

- Live TV shows in system media controls, Now Playing and Google Assistant
- Next and previous change channel from media controls and the companion remote
- A short rewind at the live edge moves back instead of doing nothing
- Guide reloads and recording rule runs report failures instead of claiming success
- Favorite channels are included in settings export

Jellyfin & Emby

- External players open ISO files from Jellyfin
- Downloads keep their SRT subtitles on Jellyfin
- The Collections tab lists collections on Emby servers without a collections folder

Explore & trackers

- Unwatching resets MAL and AniList progress instead of deleting the list entry
- A failed watchlist add on Plex shows an error instead of doing nothing

Downloads

- Downloads stop before the device runs out of storage
- Show and season badges count downloaded episodes
- Downloads from different servers no longer merge into one show or album
- A shared download removed from a profile leaves that profile's list
- The offline play-next card shows its thumbnail on Jellyfin and Emby

UI

- Error messages no longer show raw technical text
- Titles without a logo get a wider slot and shrink to fit instead of truncating
- Low-density phones get the phone layout instead of the tablet one
- Hovering an always-open sidebar no longer dims the content
- Settings that fail to apply show why instead of crashing
- Out-of-date translations refreshed in every language

TV

- Plezy no longer renders upside down on some Android TV boxes
- The on-screen keyboard takes D-pad input on Chromecast with Google TV
- The focused player control is a solid disc that stands out over video
- Holding Select opens the context menu on playlist items
- The server activities cancel button is reachable with a remote

Android

- Non-16:9 video is letterboxed again on Android 7 and 8
- High-bitrate AV1 plays smoothly on Pixel 6 and newer
- Locking and unlocking during playback no longer blacks out the picture or desyncs audio
- The display no longer switches between 120 and 60 Hz mid-playback
- Frame pacing recovers after seeking on some tablets
- The performance overlay reports dropped frames accurately

Desktop

- HDR plays in HDR on macOS instead of tone-mapped to SDR
- Audio device changes no longer crash playback on macOS
- The player's fullscreen button follows fullscreen state on Windows
- The window no longer stays blank when FancyZones resizes it at launch
- Plezy no longer leaves .sentry-native folders in random directories on Windows
- Companion Remote can host on more Linux and Windows network adapters
- Discord presence hides while paused

apps.name: Twitch
apps.subtitle: Twitch with TwitchAdBlock
apps.localizedDescription:
Twitch with the unofficial TwitchAdBlock tweak for sideloading.

It blocks live-stream and VOD ads, removes feed promotions and ad-network requests, supports authenticated and fallback proxies, renders 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, and adds app customization options.

This source mirrors the patched Twitch IPA published by gunnerkidBT's TwitchAdBlock fork. The fork maintains compatibility with newer Twitch and iOS versions and is not affiliated with Twitch Interactive.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream asset: "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
TwitchMods v0.1.13 — for Twitch iOS 30.7

New in v0.1.13
- Casting & AirPlay now work with ad-blocking on. Previously, having the ad-block proxy enabled could make casting to a Chromecast crash after a few seconds, or make AirPlay to an Apple TV show "offline." The mod now automatically steps aside while you're casting/AirPlaying, so the stream plays on the TV — and your phone goes right back to blocking ads the moment you stop. (The stream *on the TV* still shows ads — the TV fetches the video itself, so that can't be blocked — but your phone stays ad-free.)

Everything else (v0.1.12)
- Blocks ads (live + VOD pre-rolls, feed banners, sponsor spots, the "Go Ad-Free" Turbo button)
- Keep Live Feed Playing · 7TV/BTTV/FFZ chat emotes + Reload · settings backup/restore · Diagnostics · launch screen · hide Stories

Downloads
- "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa" — full app.
- "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13-noplugins.ipa" — app extensions removed so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Install with AltStore / SideStore (drag in the IPA) or TrollStore (tap +, pick the IPA).

Full plain-language changelog: ["CHANGELOG.md"](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

apps.name: YouTube
apps.subtitle: YouTube with YTKACE
apps.localizedDescription:
YTKACE is an open-source YouTube enhancement for iOS.

It adds video, audio and Shorts downloads, background playback, PiP, playback speed controls, SponsorBlock, interface customization, tab editing, a download library, and searchable settings.

Two IPA builds are published: an iOS 16-compatible build based on YouTube 21.33.6, and an iOS 17+ build based on the latest supported YouTube version.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.0.1
Upstream asset: "YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_21.38.2.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.38.2
• Download subtitles with your videos
• Transcript button to copy or share a video's captions
• Added toggle to Open videos paused instead of playing right away
• Search bar in YTKACE settings

Fixed:
• Crash on iOS 15
• Prevent Open in Shorts doing nothing
• Stop Autoplay doing nothing
• Queue not appearing until the video was reopened
• Captions turning off after Playback Fix recovers a video

YouTube 21.38.2 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• "YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_21.38.2.ipa" for iOS 17 and newer
• "YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa" for iOS 16

Upstream release: https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.0.0
Upstream asset: "YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.37.5
• Queue videos without Premium — play next, play last, reorder, shuffle, loop and clear
• Playlist downloads — grab every video or pick the ones you want
• YouTube's Download button can now open the YTKACE menu
• Choose where the download button lives: player overlay, YouTube's button, or both
• Save downloads to the share sheet, with separate video and audio destinations
• Hide the products shelf
• iOS 15 support for the tweak packages

Fixed:
• 2K and 4K missing from the download quality list
• Shorts Save button not removed unless YouTube was in English
• Community posts breaking with Block Premium Prompts on
• Action bar disappearing while scrolling the feed
• Settings unreachable if both the YTKACE and Library tabs were removed
• YTKACE settings opening another tweak's settings when both were installed

YouTube 21.37.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• "YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5.ipa" for iOS 17 and newer
• "YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa" for iOS 16
